sections.title: basic_coroutine(), coroutine_with_args(), demonstrate_basic_async()
sections.body:
Basic coroutine function Coroutine that takes arguments Demonstrate basic async/await concepts

```python
async def basic_coroutine():
    """Basic coroutine function"""
    print("🚀 Starting basic coroutine")
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Simulate async work
    print("✅ Basic coroutine completed")
    return "Hello from coroutine!"

async def coroutine_with_args(name, delay):
    """Coroutine that takes arguments"""
    print(f"🚀 {name} starting with {delay}s delay")
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    print(f"✅ {name} completed")
    return f"Result from {name}"

async def demonstrate_basic_async():
    """Demonstrate basic async/await concepts"""
    print("=" * 60)
    print("BASIC ASYNC/AWAIT DEMONSTRATION")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("\n1. Running a single coroutine:")
    result = await basic_coroutine()
    print(f"📝 Result: {result}")

    print("\n2. Running multiple coroutines concurrently:")
    start_time = time.time()

    # Create tasks for concurrent execution
    task1 = asyncio.create_task(coroutine_with_args("Task-1", 2))
    task2 = asyncio.create_task(coroutine_with_args("Task-2", 1))
    task3 = asyncio.create_task(coroutine_with_args("Task-3", 3))

    # Wait for all tasks to complete
    results = await asyncio.gather(task1, task2, task3)
    end_time = time.time()

    print(f"📊 Results: {results}")
    print(f"⏱️  Total time: {end_time - start_time:.2f}s (would be ~6s sequentially)")

    print("\n3. Using asyncio.gather() directly:")
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        coroutine_with_args("Gather-1", 1),
        coroutine_with_args("Gather-2", 1),
        coroutine_with_args("Gather-3", 1),
    )
    print(f"📝 Gather results: {results}")
```

sections.body:
Simulate an I/O operation (file read, network request, etc.) Demonstrate async I/O operations

```python
async def simulate_io_operation(operation_name, duration):
    """Simulate an I/O operation (file read, network request, etc.)"""
    print(f"📡 {operation_name}: Starting I/O operation")
    await asyncio.sleep(duration)  # Simulate I/O delay
    print(f"✅ {operation_name}: I/O operation completed")
    return f"Data from {operation_name}"

async def demonstrate_async_io():
    """Demonstrate async I/O operations"""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("ASYNC I/O OPERATIONS DEMONSTRATION")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("\n1. Sequential vs Concurrent I/O operations:")

    # Sequential execution
    print("\n📋 Sequential execution:")
    start_time = time.time()
    result1 = await simulate_io_operation("File Read", 2)
    result2 = await simulate_io_operation("Database Query", 2)
    result3 = await simulate_io_operation("API Call", 2)
    sequential_time = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"⏱️  Sequential time: {sequential_time:.2f}s")

    # Concurrent execution
    print("\n🚀 Concurrent execution:")
    start_time = time.time()
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        simulate_io_operation("File Read", 2),
        simulate_io_operation("Database Query", 2),
        simulate_io_operation("API Call", 2),
    )
    concurrent_time = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"⏱️  Concurrent time: {concurrent_time:.2f}s")
    print(f"🚀 Speedup: {sequential_time/concurrent_time:.1f}x faster!")
```

sections.title: demonstrate_task_management()
sections.body:
Demonstrate different task management patterns

```python
async def demonstrate_task_management():
    """Demonstrate different task management patterns"""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("TASK MANAGEMENT DEMONSTRATION")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("\n1. Creating and managing individual tasks:")
    task1 = asyncio.create_task(long_running_task(1, 3))
    task2 = asyncio.create_task(long_running_task(2, 1))

    # Check task status
    print(f"📊 Task-1 done: {task1.done()}")
    print(f"📊 Task-2 done: {task2.done()}")

    # Wait for specific task
    result2 = await task2
    print(f"📝 Task-2 result: {result2}")

    # Wait for remaining task
    result1 = await task1
    print(f"📝 Task-1 result: {result1}")

    print("\n2. Using asyncio.wait() with timeout:")
    tasks = [
        asyncio.create_task(long_running_task(i, random.uniform(1, 4)))
        for i in range(3, 6)
    ]

    done, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=2.5)
    print(f"✅ Completed tasks: {len(done)}")
    print(f"⏳ Pending tasks: {len(pending)}")

    # Cancel pending tasks
    for task in pending:
        task.cancel()

    print("\n3. Using asyncio.as_completed():")
    tasks = [
        asyncio.create_task(long_running_task(i, random.uniform(1, 3)))
        for i in range(6, 9)
    ]

    for completed_task in asyncio.as_completed(tasks):
        result = await completed_task
        print(f"🎯 Completed: {result}")
```

sections.title: risky_operation(), demonstrate_error_handling()
sections.body:
Simulate an operation that might fail Demonstrate error handling in async code

```python
async def risky_operation(operation_id, should_fail=False):
    """Simulate an operation that might fail"""
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    if should_fail:
        raise ValueError(f"Operation {operation_id} failed!")
    return f"Operation {operation_id} succeeded"

async def demonstrate_error_handling():
    """Demonstrate error handling in async code"""
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("ERROR HANDLING DEMONSTRATION")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("\n1. Handling errors in individual coroutines:")
    try:
        result = await risky_operation(1, should_fail=True)
        print(f"✅ Result: {result}")
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f"❌ Caught error: {e}")

    print("\n2. Error handling with asyncio.gather():")
    try:
        results = await asyncio.gather(
            risky_operation(2, should_fail=False),
            risky_operation(3, should_fail=True),
            risky_operation(4, should_fail=False),
        )
        print(f"✅ All results: {results}")
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f"❌ Gather failed: {e}")

    print("\n3. Using return_exceptions=True:")
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        risky_operation(5, should_fail=False),
        risky_operation(6, should_fail=True),
        risky_operation(7, should_fail=False),
        return_exceptions=True,
    )

    for i, result in enumerate(results, 5):
        if isinstance(result, Exception):
            print(f"❌ Operation {i} failed: {result}")
        else:
            print(f"✅ Operation {i} succeeded: {result}")

```
